head: cff3b2a6b7ad6cdd2f899bb4d564a4c03dae2d37
purpose: Selected Red-versus-modeled-walking decision diagnostic; no candidate or tuning.
geometries: For each source, destinations 48 and 4; exact source coordinate and 150m due-west longitude offset (150/(111320*cos(lat))) as stationary hypothetical explicit origins. 40 independent sessions.
sessions: Begin first actual poll >= pin-60sec, retain candidate board/alight/plannedRideSec through departure+180sec; empty-plan roster recovery matches shell. No user refresh, GPS movement, future planning or aboard state.
checkpoints: Every observed poll in selected windows, plus first actual poll >= source pin+[0,60,180,300]sec before departure and departure+[0,15,60]sec. Missing remains missing.
forecast: Current HEAD release ON, archived preSep14 marginal calibration and preSep10 release fit. All actual Red observations stepped continuously; reset >60sec recording gaps. No future outcomes as inputs; reconstructed collector clock provenance.
comparison: Full actual ServerEta wire at all stops/all observed Red buses. Match round2 focal 11/48/4 forecasts on overlap after transport rounding, including both occurrences. Minimum bus warm age reported, not filtered away.
decision: Use current planTrip and a mechanically extracted current shell live-map body, actual journeyArrival, stableTripOrder and visibility with persistent state. Keep countdown and catchable bus/occurrence distinct. Until a bounded actual-shell fixture passes, call this extracted numerical-path evidence, not browser/display validation.
usefulness: Describe identity/availability/tiers/order changes, pending rank persistence, modeled walking saving, predicted point/window comparisons. A switch or slower median is not automatically a defect. Connect actual endpoint outcomes only with exact chosen bus/board/alight/occurrence; report missing/ambiguous chains. No actual rider intent/walk/deadline probability is observed.
limits: Deliberately selected worst prior ETA windows; not population or fresh holdout.
Archive contains Red only; no all-route comparison.
150m geometric offset is hypothetical and does not verify walkable street access.
No new coefficients, thresholds, caps, outcome exclusions or shared semantics changes.
